package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"roundfix/internal/runevent"
	"roundfix/internal/store"
	roundtui "roundfix/internal/tui"
)

type task10CLIObservations struct {
	Events             []map[string]any `json:"events"`
	AttachTimeline     []string         `json:"attach_timeline"`
	ReconcileCompleted []string         `json:"reconcile_completed_tasks"`
	VerificationPassed bool             `json:"reconcile_verification_passed"`
	SettledCompleted   bool             `json:"reconcile_settled_completed"`
	GCRunIDs           []string         `json:"gc_run_ids"`
	GCJournalRows      int              `json:"gc_journal_rows"`
}

func TestTask10PrechangeJournalCLIConsumers(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := os.Getenv("TASK10_CORPUS_DB")
	expectations := os.Getenv("TASK10_EXPECTATIONS")
	if fixture == "" || expectations == "" {
		t.Fatal("TASK10_CORPUS_DB and TASK10_EXPECTATIONS are required")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	home := task10CopyCorpus(t, fixture)
	task10MigrateCorpus(t, ctx, home)
	reader, err := store.OpenReader(ctx, home)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("open recorded journal: %v", err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = reader.Close() }()
	runs, err := reader.ListRuns(ctx, store.ListRunsQuery{States: store.StatesAll})
	if err != nil || len(runs) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("load recorded Run: runs=%d err=%v", len(runs), err)
	}
	run := runs[0]

	var eventOutput bytes.Buffer
	if _, err := replayEventStream(ctx, reader, run.ID, 0, runevent.AllStreamCategories(), json.NewEncoder(&eventOutput)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("events consumer: %v", err)
	}
	eventLines := bytes.Split(bytes.TrimSpace(eventOutput.Bytes()), []byte("\n"))
	events := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(eventLines))
	for _, line := range eventLines {
		var record map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &record); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode events consumer record: %v", err)
		}
		events = append(events, record)
	}

	timeline := roundtui.NewRunTimeline(100)
	if _, err := replayRunEvents(ctx, reader, run.ID, 0, timeline); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("attach consumer: %v", err)
	}

	coverage, evidenceByRun, err := loadReconcileTaskCoverage(ctx, reader, runs)
	if err != nil || len(coverage) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("reconcile replay consumer: coverage=%d err=%v", len(coverage), err)
	}
	taskEvidence := evidenceByRun[run.ID]["task_02"]

	gcHome := task10CopyCorpus(t, fixture)
	gcStore, err := store.Open(ctx, gcHome)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("open GC corpus: %v", err)
	}
	report, err := pruneRunRetention(ctx, gcStore, t.TempDir(), time.Date(2021, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	if closeErr := gcStore.Close(); err == nil {
		err = closeErr
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("gc consumer: %v", err)
	}

	got := task10CLIObservations{
		Events:             events,
		AttachTimeline:     timeline.Lines(),
		ReconcileCompleted: coverage[0].CompletedTasks,
		VerificationPassed: taskEvidence.verificationPassed,
		SettledCompleted:   taskEvidence.settledCompleted,
		GCRunIDs:           report.RunIDs,
		GCJournalRows:      report.JournalRows,
	}
	if os.Getenv("TASK10_RECORD") == "1" {
		task10WriteJSON(t, expectations, got)
		return
	}
	var want task10CLIObservations
	task10ReadJSON(t, expectations, &want)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("pre-change consumer observations changed\nwant: %#v\n got: %#v", want, got)
	}
}

func task10MigrateCorpus(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, home string) {
	t.Helper()
	runStore, err := store.Open(ctx, home)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("migrate copied corpus: %v", err)
	}
	if err := runStore.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("close migrated corpus: %v", err)
	}
}

func task10CopyCorpus(t *testing.T, source string) string {
	t.Helper()
	home := t.TempDir()
	destination := store.DatabasePath(home)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(source)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read corpus: %v", err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destination), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create corpus home: %v", err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(destination, data, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copy corpus: %v", err)
	}
	return home
}

func task10WriteJSON(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal observations: %v", err)
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, data, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write observations: %v", err)
	}
}

func task10ReadJSON(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read observations: %v", err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, value); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode observations: %v", err)
	}
}
